- SSO/SAML integration details (IdP metadata, SP-initiated flow, session timeout controls)
- SCIM provisioning API: endpoints, attributes, and SCIM delta vs bulk behavior
- RBAC / admin controls: how org admins invite/manage seats and role mappings

2) If you have a vendor security questionnaire, happy to complete it — we can do that via our secure portal (I'll send a link).
3) If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute technical call next week with Aditya (our integrations lead) to walk through SAML/SCIM specifics.

I attached the three files I mentioned. If there are any additional stakeholders (infosec, procurement) who should be copied, please let me know and I'll loop them in.

Thanks — talk soon.

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the questionnaire. A few answers up front and next steps: 

SOC 2 / HIPAA / data residency:
- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025 and our most recent SOC 2 Type II audit completed on 2026-08-15. I'll attach the redacted report (redwood_soc2_report_redacted.pdf) and share a secured link to the full report for your security team.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment and contractual BAAs. For hosted/Dedicated we can sign a BAA for covered use cases. Key controls: encryption at rest and in transit, retention and deletion controls, and comprehensive audit logging.
- Data residency: We offer region selection for dedicated and private deployments. For pilot we can provision US-only tenancy.

IAM evidence we're attaching now:
- redwood_sso_metadata.xml — SP metadata and recommended ACS/Entity IDs
- redwood_scim_api_overview.pdf — endpoints, attributes, and pagination behavior

Vendor questionnaire / portal: 
- I've uploaded your questionnaire to our secure vendor portal and initiated the intake for deal CERS-2026-1143: https://redwood-inference.secure-portal.com/vendor-questionnaire/CERS-1143
- You'll receive an email from the portal with an intake link; our security team will complete the technical sections and return the questionnaire within 3 business days.

Technical sync: Aditya and I are available Nov 9 at 09:00 PST or Nov 10 at 11:00 PST — do either of those work? If not, propose alternatives.

Hi Laura — Aditya here (Integrations Lead). Thanks for sharing the questionnaire. A few technical clarifications before our call: 

1) SCIM: our SCIM implementation supports v2.0, incremental provisioning (PATCH for updates), and full sync via /Users endpoint. We support common attributes (userName, givenName, familyName, emails, active) and custom attribute mapping via tenant settings.

2) SSO sessions: we honor session timeout controls from the IdP; additionally we support configurable idle timeout per org. SAML metadata includes entityID and ACS URLs in the attached XML. 

3) RBAC: Redwood exposes org-level roles (Owner, Admin, Developer, Viewer) mapped to granular route-based permissions in the console. Admins can assign roles via SCIM groups or the console UI; we'll provide screenshots during the tech call.

Looking forward to the sync — Nov 9 at 09:00 PST works for me. Please send a calendar invite and let me know if you'd like any pre-reads.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Lead Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference
